name: Thruststrike
description: Thrust the spear's point straight along the shaft from the lead hand into the target's chest line.

name: Level Ferrule
description: Push the rear hand forward after contact so the leaf-blade sinks deeper into the target.

name: Bindcord Lid
description: Lift the shaft crosswise above the head to turn a downward blow aside along the wood.

name: Sideways Beatback
description: Slide the lead foot forward and bring the rear foot after it, closing distance without lifting either heel.

name: Sharp Slideshaft
description: Swing the blunt rear end of the shaft forward into a target that has slipped inside the point.

name: Longshaft Husk
description: Drop the shaft low and angle it sideways to knock a leg strike away from the shins.

name: Spearpoint Strike
description: Pull the spear back after a touch so the leaf-shaped edge draws a shallow cut along the target.

name: Buttshoe Trot
description: Step diagonally while keeping the spear point trained on the opponent's centre so the line never drops.

name: Nabbing Collarband
description: Rap the shaft against the opponent's weapon wrist to loosen the grip and open the line.

name: Downward Pushthrough
description: Let the shaft glide through the lead hand during a thrust so the point gains a full hand of reach.

name: Angled Leafhead
description: Spin the shaft in a close circle before the body to scatter a flurry of small blows.

name: Raised Heelspike
description: Plant the butt of the shaft against the heel and lower the point to meet a rushing target.

name: Socketdash
description: Time a thrust into the chest of a charging target so its own speed drives it onto the point.

name: Single Stretch
description: Step aside from a rush and jab the point into the target's exposed flank as it passes.

name: Spearstay
description: Press the shaft crosswise against the target's chest to hold it at the length of the haft.

name: Twirlamble
description: Push off the back foot to spring clear after a thrust, drawing the point free as the body moves.

name: Pointdrop
description: Raise the point to the target's collarbone and thrust at the soft hollow above it.

name: Wide Bladewings
description: Slide both hands to the rear of the shaft and thrust from the far end for greatest reach.

name: Pointbump
description: Rotate the hips toward the target as the spear thrusts so the whole body drives the point.

name: Flat Bindcord
description: Thrust upward at a shallow angle into the target's lower belly from a crouched stance.

name: Thrusthit
description: Lower the point and thrust at the outer thigh to slow a closing opponent.

name: Solid Collarband
description: Sweep the shaft toward the body's inside to push an incoming thrust away from the centre.

name: Bladewings Husk
description: Sweep the shaft outward to push an incoming thrust past the shoulder and away from the body.

name: Low Spearpoint
description: Step the lead foot along one side of a triangle and thrust at the opponent as the rear foot lands.

name: Swaying Buttshoe
description: Pull the rear foot back and drag the lead foot after it while holding the point forward.

name: Spearbump
description: Turn on the lead foot and swing the shaft around the body to strike a target at the flank.

name: Kept Ferrule
description: Crouch with the point low and the haft angled out to guard the knees and shins.

name: Short Longshaft
description: Slip off the line of an attack with a small side step and jab the point back into the opening.

name: Socketlid
description: Hold the point at the very edge of its reach so the opponent cannot step in without meeting it.

name: Short Thrust
description: Choke up on the short haft and stab the point into a target at arm's length.

name: Sudden Heelspike
description: Reverse the spear and drive the iron-shod butt into a target at the side or rear.

name: Socketstay
description: Turn side-on with the shaft braced across the body to hold a narrow passage against one opponent.

name: Locking Slideshaft
description: Brace the shaft against a frame and a target's chest to pin the target in place.

name: Catching Leafhead
description: Hook the blade's base behind a limb or cloth and pull the target off balance.

name: Pointdash
description: Flick the point up from a low carry into a rising jab at the target's wrist.

name: Twirlbump
description: Send a thread of circulating qi down the shaft so the point lands with added firmness in the thrust.

name: Hooding Leafhead
description: Warm the wood with qi and turn the shaft to turn a blow aside with firm control.

name: Backward Beatback
description: Exhale on the step so the qi-aided leg closes a gap of two paces smoothly.

name: Thrustdash
description: Drive the hips and a pulse of qi into a jab that sinks the leaf-blade past surface layers.

name: Judging Heelspike
description: Hold the point steady with a slow qi flow so the hand stays calm and the line stays true.

name: Nimble Stretch
description: Draw the spear back along the same line with a breath so the next thrust begins without a gap.

name: Descending Pushthrough
description: Step deep with the lead foot and extend the whole arm so the point reaches its furthest line.

name: Ready Ferrule
description: Pull the spear back to guard right after a thrust, ending the opening a miss creates.

name: Slideshaft Blow
description: Poke the point at the edge of the opponent's reach to learn its distance and reaction.

name: Spearlid
description: Strike the opponent's weapon with the shaft backed by qi to knock it off line.

name: Heelspike Husk
description: Return the shaft to the body's centre line as a parry that blocks a counter-thrust.

name: Holding Collarband
description: Back away while turning the point in small circles so the opponent cannot step through it.

name: Pointstrike
description: Pivot on the rear foot to add a hand of reach to a thrust at a moving target.

name: Even Longshaft
description: Run qi along the whole shaft in a slow wave so the hand feels where the point meets resistance.

name: Socketblow
description: Time the exhale with the thrust so qi gathered in the leaf-blade pierces a thin barrier.

name: Settled Spearpoint
description: Inhale while drawing the shaft across the body to turn aside a cut with qi in the wood.

name: Twirlblow
description: Hold the point on a small target while breath settles, then press forward in a single smooth line.

name: Pulling Bindcord
description: Lock the shaft against an opposing haft with a pulse of qi so the other weapon sticks.

name: Speardrop
description: Grip the far end of the shaft and thrust so the point arrives at maximum reach.

name: Leaden Buttshoe
description: Slide the rear hand up the shaft and thrust in tight quarters.

name: Thrustdodge
description: Slide the hands along the haft in the middle of a thrust to change reach without losing the line.

name: Bladewings Wedge
description: Slide the rear hand forward to shorten the haft and set a stable parry at the body.

name: Pushing Pushthrough
description: Rap the short-gripped shaft against an enemy blade at the forte to break its line.

name: Stiff Slideshaft
description: Slip the front hand back to the middle of the shaft and spring the point forward again.

name: Fouling Beatback
description: Choke up on the shaft and press the point against the target's collar to hold it still.

name: Sockethit
description: Release the front hand fully and let the haft slide out in a deep final lunge.

name: Forward Leafhead
description: Thrust along eight lines in turn from one stance, training the hand to reach any angle of the body.

name: Resting Bindcord
description: Cross the shaft over an incoming blade and slide it down the wood and off the body.

name: Open Stretch
description: Pulse a small measure of qi into a jab thrown on the stepping foot for quick, firm contact.

name: Gnawing Ferrule
description: Turn the leaf-blade's edge into the target and draw back to cut along the line of contact.

name: Pointwedge
description: Hook the lead foot behind the opponent's heel while the shaft holds the chest to unsettle the stance.

name: Stepping Stretch
description: Step back and aside while the point holds the original line so the opponent finds it again.

name: Straight Heelspike
description: Whip the shaft sideways in a short arc to strike the target's arm with the wood.

name: Firm Spearpoint
description: Drive the butt of the shaft straight forward into the target's chest.

name: Tight Leafhead
description: Harden the wood with a pulse of qi and block a heavy blow flat across both hands.

name: Bladewings Cowl
description: Spin the shaft with the rear hand to make a moving screen before the body.

name: Twirlwedge
description: Sweep the butt low across the ground at the ankles to unseat a standing opponent.

name: Socketstrike
description: Lift the butt straight upward under the opponent's chin from close range.

name: Thruststay
description: Catch the target's arm in the crook between haft and blade and pull it downward.

name: Blunt Buttshoe
description: Bring the shaft down from overhead in one clean line onto a target's guarding arm.
